This plot is small, only a small piece near the house where I grow maize with beans between the rows. I have some schooling so I know fertilizer helps, and here in Iringa the rains are good and maize pays if you treat it well — but one bag of DAP and one bag of urea is a lot of money for such a small piece, so I will split a bag with my brother and put a little on this plot. I will buy improved seed from the agro-dealer in town because my neighbors who used it last season got more cobs, and I will weed twice with my wife and children. I will not irrigate — I depend on the masika rains like everyone here — and I will not hire anyone for this small plot, we can manage it ourselves.
